title: Metallurgical refractory lining-guided inorganic binder for stable lithium storage in silicon microparticle anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,150-161
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03194J, Communication
Jinwei Zhou, Siyao Wu, Yang Li, Qihou Li, Feixiang Wu
Inspired by metallurgical refractory linings, this study proposes an inorganic aluminum dihydrogen phosphate binder for μSi anodes, which forms a cross-linked inorganic rigid network, effectively mitigating expansion issues in μSi.
